_doc: ansatz (conjecture_machine) active blinding embargoes. tools/blind_check.py runs on every outgoing SendMessage via the PreToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json and BLOCKS a hit. Open an embargo when a blind exchange starts (recipient "*" so uds:/tmp socket addresses cannot slip past); lift it only when its seal arrives, and record the commit. Template: TheBridge/tools (fleet practice 3, 2026-10-18). Inbound blinding (what not to READ) is not enforceable here: list it in the prereg disclosures.

embargoes.until: the Bridge arranges the TS2 uncertainty-exponent comparison with tabula's §200 and both sides are sealed (record commits)
embargoes.note: tabula §200 measures an uncertainty exponent near the TS2 plunge boundary (methodological overlap). Outbound blind for ansatz's alpha values, fate-map counts and saddle-test N(t)/h. Inbound: do not read tabula's §200 numbers.

embargoes.until: any further comparison (e.g. tabula) is arranged by the Bridge and sealed
embargoes.note: Re-imposed after the V20 send (values went to the Bridge only, 43cde03).

embargoes.until: the Bridge arranges a comparison of the edge-link tests and the ansatz verdict is sealed (record commit)
embargoes.note: EDGE_LINK_PREREGISTRATION.md: outbound blind for TS band edges, strand positions, T-L3 counter values and T-SWITCH class counts at the capture-edge level. Verdict words (LINK SUPPORTED / LINK FALSIFIED / NOT ESTABLISHED / VOID / VACUOUS) and seals may be sent.

lifted.until: the Bridge arranges a comparison and the ansatz tangle verdict is sealed (record commit)
lifted.note: TANGLE_PREREGISTRATION.md: outbound blind for TS splitting angle, multipliers, fixed point at the capture-edge level. Verdict word (TRANSVERSE / NOT RESOLVED / VOID) and seals may be sent.
lifted.lifted: 2026-11-18: Bridge V20 sealed (TheBridge 8b7eb6f, V20_SEALED.json sha256 6665007f…3d2a, verified by hash without reading); values sent to the Bridge for the registered one-way-blind comparison; re-imposed right after as ansatz-tangle-ts-capture-edge-2
